full_page.content:
1945, September 23
The following is a photocopy of a handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F.M.Cap., and a faithful transcription of it.
ST. MICHAEL'S CHURCH 225 JEROME STREET BROOKLYN 7, N.Y. September 23rd, 1945
Miss Grace Panyard Muskegon, Michigan
Dear Miss Panyard:
God bless you and yours. Before further delay this time I'll just write "Thank you" and God bless you for the favor just noted which you sent me spe- cial day-before yesterday. Also for a number of others never formally acknowledged.
We are having 40 Hour Devotion till Tuesday- night and I hope to purpose to remember you all in Muskegon. I'l pray for yours,
Fraternally
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
The original in possession of: Doris Panyard 3248 Maple Grove Rd. Apt. 37 Muskegon, Mich. 49441
